message: which_key: Unify preparation and rendering for which-key and the pending keystrokes indicator (#64522) This PR shares grouping, sorting, duplicate handling, and list rendering between which-key and the pending keystrokes indicator. Which-key keeps its existing list behavior. The indicator adopts that behavior and replaces its 10-entry limit with scrolling. **What changes?** | Area | Which-key popup | Indicator popover | |---|---|---| | Grouping | Unchanged | ***Groups bindings with the same next key under `+N keybinds`, instead of listing each action*** | | Sorting and duplicates | Unchanged | ***Uses which-key's existing rules***, detailed below | | Key display | ***Uses keybinding components instead of standalone text labels***, preserving Vim-style notation | Keeps keybinding components | | Header | ***Adds "is waiting for more keys…" beside the pending keys***; keeps the divider | Keeps the waiting message; ***adds a divider*** | | Rows | Keeps aligned columns and truncated action labels; ***uses smaller labels and fixed row heights*** | ***Adds aligned columns, fixed row heights, truncated action labels, and highlighted group counts*** | | Long lists | Remains scrollable | ***Shows all prepared rows in a scrollable list, instead of the first 10*** | | Scroll position | ***Resets when pending keys change or clear*** | ***Resets when pending keys change or clear*** | Sorting puts individual bindings before groups, then sorts by remaining key count, key-label length, and key text. Within each group, duplicate handling removes adjacent identical key sequences even if their actions differ. After sorting, it removes adjacent identical key/action rows. **What is shared?** - Grouping, sorting, duplicate handling, and the resulting rows. - The pending-key header, divider, key formatting, columns, action labels, and scrollable list. - Tests for list preparation and key display. **What remains separate?** | Part | Which-key popup | Pending keystrokes indicator | |---|---|---| | Filtering | Excludes a hardcoded set of Vim-related sequences | Does not apply those exclusions | | Container | Bottom-right modal with its own size limits | Tooltip-styled popover anchored to the status bar item | | Interaction | Automatic opening, modal focus, and dismissal | Status bar button, countdown, click action, hover handling, and timeout pausing/resuming | The pending keystrokes indicator is hidden in Vim/Helix mode, so it does not need which-key's Vim-related filtering. This refactor preserves each view's existing filtering and visibility behavior. **Screenshots** | | Before | After | |---|---|---| | Which-key | | | | Which-key (Vim mode) | | | | Indicator popover | | | Release Notes: - Improved the pending keystrokes indicator with grouped bindings, a scrollable list, and a clearer layout.
